'''Neddis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He was tasked with organizing bomber attacks on shielded [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] targets.
